<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>ג׳ כולא</he> (<cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite>) the entire body (of the chicken).
<cite ref="Shabbat 65b:2">Sabb. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא לילפן ג׳ נכראה</he> that they might not become used to bodily contact.

senses.gloss: Gufa (text), a talmudical term used for taking up a text or subject after an interruption by a discussion or digression; our text says; returning to our subject, &c.
